items.title: Loading progress bar invisible
items.what: On the ShoeMoney boot screen the progress indicator is a 1-pixel brown line with zero visible fill or glow.
items.why: Players launching the game for the first time see no feedback that anything is downloading.
items.how: Increase bar height to 4 px, add a warm gold fill that matches the title text, and show a small percentage label.

items.title: Player names unreadable at top
items.what: The top bar shows “ASMONGOlD” and “HASANABI” in ~11 px font next to the large gold timer circle.
items.why: On a 390 px phone the names are too small to read instantly, breaking score awareness in the first second of a round.
items.how: Bump name size to 14 px, add a subtle white outline, and shorten the timer circle diameter so the row stays balanced.

items.title: Joystick hit areas too small
items.what: The stance and technique circles sit inside 120 px rings with 8 px arrow icons; the actual touch zone matches the ring exactly.
items.why: Thumb occlusion on portrait phone makes precise 8-way inputs unreliable, especially during rapid stance changes.
items.how: Expand each joystick’s touch rect to 160 px, keep the visible ring at 120 px, and add a faint outer glow on press.

items.title: Move callout covers fighters
items.what: When a technique executes, the black pill (“REVERSE PUNCH”, “LUNGE PUNCH”, “IPPON”) sits dead-center at eye level over the 3D models.
items.why: It hides the exact moment of impact the player needs to see to learn timing.
items.how: Move the pill 80 px higher or make it 30 % transparent with a 200 ms fade so the strike animation remains visible.

items.title: Settings row has stray yellow border
items.what: In the settings panel the “Show performance HUD” row carries a persistent gold outline while every other toggle does not.
items.why: It looks like a stuck focus state and draws the eye away from the actual toggle switches on a touch screen.
items.how: Remove the outline unless the row is actively highlighted by keyboard or controller navigation.
